mission: Capacity75 session 8 (2026-10-10): encode RAW snapshots before the first INSERT (no plaintext TOAST row version); collector releases now roll out one at a time with all-or-nothing rollback; collector_variables recovery scan widened; sequential ten-collector release, daily-v1 unchanged

impacts.reason: raw_dictionary_storage is in both collectors' import graph, so this is a collector release (all ten). The writer reserves the snapshot ID from the serial sequence after admission/base/savings checks, verifies reconstruction, then INSERTs the envelope once; previously a plaintext INSERT then UPDATE left a dead TOAST body until vacuum. Ledger (original_sha256/original_bytes/base) and content_hash unchanged; daily-v1 admission, try-lock, savings threshold, plaintext fallback, readers and backup19 unchanged. No schema change. Tests reproduce the defect with a PostgreSQL write trigger.

Recovery-source scan widened from 20 to 100 deployments so the exact-image rollback/settings path still finds a redeployable copy behind SKIPPED merge records (SNKR had none within 20). Same allowlist, staging pins, digest and read-back checks.
Documents the writer change and records the read-only fleet/storage preflight and rollback procedure.

Delivery rollout becomes sequential: every collector's rollback source is proven before any upload; forward release starts only 06:00-23:00 UTC; each collector is uploaded only in its own safe slot (>=5 min after a fire, >=8 min before the next, no open attempt), followed to SUCCESS and re-verified (marker, schedule, start command, writer flags) before the next; any failure restores every touched collector newest-first via collector_variables.restore. Delivery job timeout 60 -> 180 min. Stricter than before; no new provider capability, credential or source request.

resources.name: Staging Postgres (no migration; writer rows only through ordinary scheduled captures)

routes: Existing admitted ordinary RAW captures; no manual source invocation
dependencies: f9e5b4a8c012 schema, e8 dependency protection, readers and portable backup19 unchanged; envelope/ledger representation identical
impact.deployment_impact: Native ten-collector image update plus API (shared package), released ONE AT A TIME by the sequential delivery rollout, each in its own safe slot and verified before the next. Crons, start commands, budgets, pacing, claim cap, SNKR singleton and daily-v1 variables unchanged and re-verified after each. Verifiers await completed natural runs on the new component for SNKR and all nine shards.

recovery.procedure: Automatic and all-or-nothing: on any rollout failure the delivery restores every collector already touched, newest first, to its recorded original image (commit 1b1b64d, digests in the preflight) and flags via collector_variables.restore, verifying digest, marker, schedule, start command and variables after each. After delivery, the same restore is run manually per collector (scripts/collector_variables.py --restore --expect-digest) if a natural-run trigger fires; then native revert of this PR. Recovery sources are canRedeploy=true with the identical digest (fleet preflight 07:31Z; re-proven by the rollout before any upload). No data rollback: new rows use the identical envelope/ledger the activation readers decode. No RAW expansion, no Run Now.
recovery.trigger: any lossless verification failure on a new encoded row; writer errors or collection failures above baseline; source denial, 403/429/challenge, duplicate or uncontrolled request, lease/reservation leak; deployment failure; schedule, start command or writer variable drift; 24h freshness regression
recovery.backup: No schema or historical RAW change; existing 3,253+ encoded rows verified lossless in session 7 and re-verified with every new row after delivery. Activation images retained and redeployable.

verification.observation_window: Delivery artifact plus completed natural runs on the new component for SNKR and all nine shards. Then: every new encoded row lossless (verify_all), raw_snapshots n_tup_upd not increasing with encoded inserts, ledger rows/bytes within daily-v1 bounds, 0 denials/403/429/challenges, no lease or reservation leaks, freshness unchanged. Next collector release only after at least one natural turn per collector.
